title: Samosa platform layer component diagram
description: A model of the ZX Spectrum, for this game's look: the display as a bitmap and attribute grid, its own font, one-key-at-a-time input and beeper sound. Nothing here knows the game.

components.name: ZXScreen (screen.ts)
components.responsibility: 256×192 one-bit bitmap, 32×24 attributes (INK, PAPER, BRIGHT, FLASH) and a border; renders to RGBA as a pure function.

components.name: Display (display.ts)
components.responsibility: Shows a ZXScreen on a canvas, toggles FLASH every 0.32 s and scales to fit.

components.name: Font (font.ts)
components.responsibility: An 8×8 character set drawn for this project, not the Sinclair ROM font.

components.name: Input (input.ts)
components.responsibility: Every prompt waits for one key; on touch screens a keypad offers the keys that matter.

components.name: Sound (sound.ts)
components.responsibility: Beeper-style square-wave notes, rests and noise.
